Description:
Capture the spirit of adventure and discovery with this captivating vintage Agate Geode Diorama. Inside a hand-cut agate geode, which showcases natural layers of colorful mineral bands, stands a detailed metal figurine of a bearded miner wielding a pickaxe. Beside him, a faithful pack donkey is carefully sculpted and packed for the journey, set against the sparkling mineral backdrop. These crafted elements highlight the heritage of mining and exploration, making this piece both visually stunning and historically evocative. The blend of natural stone beauty and intricate metalwork offers a unique statement for shelves, desks, or curio cabinets. The piece is sturdy, displays beautifully from multiple angles, and easily fits into mining or mineral collections. Its versatile size makes it an ideal conversation starter and a memorable gift for collectors or anyone who appreciates geology and craftsmanship. Condition is good, with visible minor roughness typical for raw stone edges. No major chips or damage are observed

Set of 3 Vintage Hemingray 42 and Whitall Tatum Glass Insulators

It features two Hemingray-42 insulators, one in aqua blue glass and one in clear glass, both embossed with branding and model numbers. The set also includes one Whitall Tatum Co. insulator in light blue aqua glass with embossed markings. Each insulator has ridged designs and domed tops characteristic of early to mid-20th century utility glassware. These pieces show minor wear consistent with vintage use and are suitable for collectors interested in historical or decorative items.
